rv.q: Redtwist’s “Agnes of God” is perfectly cast.
The reliable ensemble at Redtwist Theatre creates an atmospheric production that leaves an indelible impression.
In a show where the casting cannot be surpassed and where all of the characters seem so authentic that you can almost touch them, every moment is a gem.

cn.t: Critics praise this atmospheric production of Pielmeier's psychological drama, with strong ensemble work exploring the tension between faith and reason in a gripping murder mystery centered on a devout young nun.
